theTwoGaps.gap2_isTheWholeQuestion: GAP 2 is not 'does the API work' -- it is 'which surface is being asked'. This lane exists to distinguish them, and knows before acting that either answer is a finding.

surfaceTaxonomy_established_before_probi: The Cloud Run service has never served a console: GET / returns {"ok":true,"service":"plan-review"} and everything outside /api/plan-review/* and /api/icc/* is 404.
The console is the Vercel-hosted web app, whose BFF attaches the service bearer token server-side.

Therefore a text search of the Cloud Run root for console markers can never find any, under EITHER mechanism -- that observation alone is uninformative, and a lane that treated it as evidence either way would be reasoning from an instrument that cannot see the thing it was asked about.

2. Reach the reasoner path for a REAL engagement on the live serving revision and read the composed payload (the pre-registered falsifier).
3. Reach the reasoner CONSOLE in a browser as a real persona and observe the markers rendered, not merely the payload.
4. GATE 2: prove the adjudicator badge is a DERIVED property of the registry, in both directions, without touching the repo.
5. Run scripts/surface-probe.mjs and cite its artifact.

writeScope.reposTouched: none. Zero files changed in plan-review or any other product repo. This lane's only writes are its own doc_repo _inbox/ artifacts, left uncommitted for the planner per AGENT_CONTRACT section 6.
writeScope.rebuildRefactorRedeploy: REFUSED unless the probe proved the deploy partial. The dispatch is explicit that a plain redeploy on a pinned service is a silent no-op that reports success, and that the canary path is the only permitted redeploy. Recorded here BEFORE probing so that the constraint cannot be re-read after the fact to fit whatever happened.
writeScope.deployTrafficLease: no Cloud Run traffic shift is planned. If the probe proved the backend stale, the dispatch's canary path (--no-traffic --tag, verify on the tag URL, then update-traffic) would be taken under a lease. If the probe instead proved the FRONTEND stale, that is a Vercel alias promotion, which the lease rule does not cover -- and this lane will say plainly which of the two it performed rather than leaving it implicit.

fires_if: (a) Route absent: the reasoner path returns 404 through the BFF.
(b) Route unreachable: non-200 for EVERY real engagement reachable.
(c) Markers absent: a 200 payload carries no row with badge === 'NO ADJUDICATOR', or the front-setback row is not 'LIVE CHECK'.
(d) Wrong route server: the serving revision is not the reasoner revision named in the dispatch.
preRegisteredFalsifier.note: The lane staked a falsifiable claim in writing before looking, and committed in advance to saying so if it lost. The outcome is recorded in CP2.

stopConditions: Any request to the live surface that would require holding, printing or storing the service bearer token: the probe goes through the BFF, which holds the key server-side, and this lane never obtains it.
A redeploy of the Cloud Run service: forbidden by the dispatch unless the probe proves the deploy partial, and then only by the canary path.
Editing any product repo: out of scope. Defects found live are recorded as leave_behind, not fixed (and one was, see CP2).
Any command not exit-bounded: every gcloud/curl/node call in this lane ran under an explicit timeout or a bounded pipe.
